name: Entity Lifecycle
description: Tracks content freshness for content entities: stamps a lifecycle status on save, scans on cron against configurable condition plugins, and surfaces content that needs review.

suggests.drupal/eca: Enables the entity_lifecycle_eca submodule with workflow automation for lifecycle transitions.
suggests.drupal/entity_usage: Enables the Entity Usage condition plugin to detect content referenced by other entities.
suggests.drupal/linkchecker: Enables the Link Checker condition plugin to detect content with broken links.
suggests.drupal/radioactivity: Enables the Radioactivity condition plugin to detect content based on visitor engagement metrics.

project_description: Entity Lifecycle tracks the freshness of content entities and surfaces material that has gone stale. It adds five base fields (lifecycle_status, lifecycle_last_reviewed, lifecycle_exclude, lifecycle_override_days, lifecycle_condition_details) to enabled entity types. Statuses are configurable 'lifecycle_status' config entities (default install ships current/needs_review/outdated) with a color, weight, is_default and requires_review flag. On every entity save the module re-stamps the entity to the default status with a fresh timestamp, so editing counts as a review. A cron scan (throttled by an interval setting) and Drush commands (entity-lifecycle:scan / :rebuild / :stats / :config) evaluate each enabled bundle's configured LifecycleCondition plugins (age, published status, catch-all default, plus optional entity-usage, broken-links, radioactivity and user-account conditions from submodules) and write a new status directly to the entity data table. Content whose status requires review shows an editor-facing banner via hook_page_top, and Views dashboards under Content, Media and People list items needing review. Configuration lives at /admin/config/content/entity-lifecycle and per-bundle via content-type/media-type forms; the LifecycleCondition plugin type and a set of hooks let other modules extend conditions, bundleless entity-type support and summary rendering.
